scope: Offline saved-node/edge/session semantics and marginal diagnostics; no UE or visual acceptance

coverage_warmup_disclosure.selection_policy_claim: For missing edited attribute targets including genuinely changed-in core values, lock a real directed edge as round one of an existing fixed job; prioritize scarce incoming support, low reuse, and new-value gain. Kind, length, start-camera quota, fork round and fork source remain unchanged. Explicit coverage sampling, not pure random selection.
coverage_warmup_disclosure.axis_weight_formula_static_review: legal base identity2/other1 times history_axis_decay**prior_axis_count_in_entire_session times global feedback; explicit coverage first steps override the axis draw

sampling_policy_disclosures.weight_formula: legal base identity2/other1 times history_axis_decay**prior_axis_count_in_entire_session times global feedback; explicit coverage first steps override the axis draw

start_camera_diagnostic.definition: Session history[0] camera, including explicit coverage jobs

single_slot_diagnostic.definition: For each actual single event, add 1/number_of_formally_available_slots to each source-legal slot; availability includes camera visibility and exact outfit rules.

vs_v5_start_camera_conditioned.definition: Compare each kind and length within identical starting camera; standardize both means to the requested 1.5/1 camera weights over common represented cameras only.
